description: The plot illustrates the impact of hyperparameter N on AUC. The x-axis is labeled "N" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "AUC (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 75 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The plot contains five solid lines, each distinguished by color and marker shape. The orange line with square markers (SMD) starts at an x-value of 1 with a y-value of approximately 92, dips to roughly 88 at x=5, peaks at approximately 98 at x=10, and ends at x=20 with a y-value near 96. The blue line with circle markers (PSM) begins at x=1 with a y-value near 98, dips slightly to about 96 at x=5, reaches a peak of approximately 99 at x=10, and concludes at x=20 with a y-value of roughly 98. The green line with upward-pointing triangle markers (SWaT) starts at x=1 with a y-value of approximately 90, rises to about 95 at x=5, peaks near 98 at x=10, and ends at x=20 with a y-value of approximately 97. The purple line with downward-pointing triangle markers (SMAP) begins at x=1 with a y-value of roughly 80, dips slightly to about 79 at x=5, reaches its peak at approximately 92 at x=10, and declines to end at x=20 with a y-value near 84. The yellow line with diamond markers (MSL) starts at x=1 with a y-value of approximately 92, rises to about 94 at x=5, peaks near 97 at x=10, and ends at x=20 with a y-value of roughly 95.
